resources.string: Local HTTPS and DNS protection status

Tunnel HTTPS uses Android's VpnService to process network packets from the apps included in protection entirely on this device. Metadata such as DNS queries, destination IP addresses and ports, and TLS host names is used to block ads and trackers and provide a local protection path. When Turbo mode is on, the app stores only keyed HMAC identifiers and performance metrics such as connection success and latency on this device, rather than the original destinations, to optimize connection strategies. When DNS encryption is on, DNS queries may be encrypted over HTTPS and sent to a selected or automatically selected external DoH provider (Cloudflare, Google, or Quad9); that provider may process your IP address and request metadata. When DNS encryption is off, the device or current network's DNS resolver handles queries. We do not send this information to our servers or sell it for advertising. This app is not a remote VPN or IP anonymization service, and it does not encrypt non-TLS traffic sent directly to its destination.
